name: elder_ray_pullback

formula.finite_ema: for every timestamp t: e = close[t-63]; for k = t-62 .. t in order: e = alpha * close[k] + (1 - alpha) * e, with alpha = 2 / (ema_period + 1). Each earlier average E(t-j) is computed independently by the same rule from its own 64 closes
formula.difference_from_unrestricted_ema: an unrestricted EMA starts once at the first input row and carries every older close with geometrically decaying weight; this finite EMA forgets everything older than 64 closes and restarts from the oldest close of the span, so its value depends only on closes[t-63 .. t] and is the same in any frame that contains them
formula.slope: S(t) = E(t) - E(t - slope_span), in price units
formula.arming: a long setup arms at bar a when L(a) is true and L(a-1) is false; the setup age at bar t is t - a. Short mirrors with H
formula.continuation: while L stays true the setup keeps its original arming bar; the same excursion never rearms
formula.long_entry: bar t with L(t-1) true, S(t) > 0, BE(t) >= 0 (zero counts as recovery) and setup age t - a <= pullback_window
formula.short_entry: bar t with H(t-1) true, S(t) < 0, BU(t) <= 0 (zero counts as recovery) and setup age t - a <= pullback_window
formula.expiry: age strictly above pullback_window: no entry on recovery; age equal to pullback_window is still eligible
formula.trend_clear: S(t) <= 0 while a long setup is live (S(t) >= 0 for short) ends the setup without an entry; a later bar where the condition is true again after a false bar arms a new setup
formula.consumption: the recovery bar ends the run, so one setup gives at most one entry
formula.required_history: 64 + slope_span + pullback_window + 1 rows: the decision reads L/H on bars t - pullback_window - 1 .. t, each needs E at that bar and slope_span bars earlier, and each E needs 64 closes; maximum 89 rows at slope_span 8 and pullback_window 16
formula.validity: a decision is made only when every row of its own required span is finite, positive, has high >= max(open, close), low <= min(open, close), volume >= 0, strictly increasing timestamps with one constant spacing, and every computed E, S, BU and BE on bars t - pullback_window - 1 .. t is finite; anything else holds with a reason code

bear_pullback_st.note: not an M1 incumbent; native short-only entries, run as a second comparison arm

selection.eligible: complete candle and funding coverage, every dataset scored, no liquidated leg, at least min_train_independent_positions independent positions

uncertainty.method: percentile bootstrap of the mean net PnL per closed position, pooled over datasets
uncertainty.role: descriptive only; positions overlap in time and are not independent, so the interval is optimistic and never a verdict input

descriptive_outputs: train vs held-out Spearman rank correlation

base.meaning: manifest fees, per-coin half spread and slippage

stress.meaning: manifest fees unchanged, half spread and slippage doubled

verdict.inconclusive: any coverage refusal, no eligible training selection for an arm, or a held-out sample gate that fails
verdict.pass: complete coverage, every sample gate met, candidate net PnL > 0 at base and stress cost, candidate base mean Sharpe and base mean drawdown-adjusted return both strictly above each selected comparator
verdict.fail: a complete study that misses any pass condition
